summary_en: 67,000 shares (1.26% of shares outstanding), ¥500M upper limit, executed via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-11 at ¥6,610/share ceiling. Parent company Tempos Holdings to participate as seller.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: ASAKUMA announced a single-day treasury share acquisition on 2026-06-11 via ToSTNeT-3 off-market transaction. The board authorized purchase of up to 67,000 shares (1.26% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) at a ceiling price of ¥6,610/share, with a ¥500M upper limit. The transaction is structured as a block purchase executed at 08:45 JST on the Tokyo Stock Exchange; the buy order is valid for that trading window only and results will be announced upon close of the session. The acquisition is intended to fund expanded employee and executive incentive plans and support flexible capital management. The parent company, Tempos Holdings Co., Ltd. (which controls ASAKUMA), is expected to participate as the seller, constituting a related-party transaction subject to governance safeguards outlined in the company's April 2026 corporate governance report.
